kind: Saved-run evidence replay, not new generation or model qualification.
checker_exceptions: Exit2 or nonzero other than assertion exit1 is a source/checker/environment exception until diagnosed; do not label all as infrastructure.
native_terminal_rule: Strict single-terminal observations are separate from the immutable any-turn.completed endpoint; no retrospective scoring change.
elapsed_rule: Literal elapsed_ms<=180000 is reported separately; no invented overhead tolerance or retrospective scoring change.
operator_boundary: Root acknowledged model/native closure; this auditor does not independently enumerate unrelated system processes.
sandbox: The original sandbox denies network and file writes, but permits file reads. Isolated Python does not imply filesystem-read isolation.
probe_retention: Only the final active-probe file per pair is retained; prior per-episode bounds are established by frozen runner semantics, setup cap and recorded request counts.
sampling: n=3 per case/profile on reused development tasks; no historical pooling, general causal claim or ordinary90-second qualification.
authority: No native tools, approvals, sandbox, execution loop, settings or routing activation are changed by this audit.
private_diagnostics: Only hashes of checker stdout/stderr are retained in safe receipts; raw requests/configurations/commands are excluded.
